title: Example · infinitely many primes (Euclid)
note: A classical theorem used to learn Euler's workflow. It is not a research result.

problem.statement: For every positive integer N there exists a prime p > N.
problem.parameter_domain: N ranges over the positive integers; p ranges over the prime numbers.
problem.definitions: A prime is an integer greater than 1 whose only positive divisors are 1 and itself.
completion_checks: An independent check accepts a complete proof of the exact statement.
problem.external_help_policy: Classical result; standard literature may be cited. This project exercises the workflow.

team.objective: Develop a complete proof of the exact statement and have the assistant review its critical step.

members.assignment: Coordinate the proof. Record proposed steps and consult the assistant on the critical step.
Check proposed steps independently and report gaps to the lead.
